title: 正方形数组的数目
summary: 统计 nums 的不同排列中，相邻元素之和均为完全平方数的排列数量；重复元素排列只计一次。
insight: 用值到剩余频次而非下标做回溯，天然去除重复排列；每步只选择与上一值之和为完全平方数的候选。
pitfalls: 相同值的不同下标不能重复计数
首个位置无需相邻约束
判断完全平方数要验证 root*root==sum

solutions.title: 频次与平方邻接回溯
solutions.idea: 在多重集合上枚举合法下一值。
steps: 枚举频次大于零的 value；若无前值或 previous+value 是平方，则频次减一递归，再恢复；累加返回

code.java: class Solution { private Map<Integer,Integer> count;private int length;public int numSquarefulPerms(int[] nums){count=new HashMap<>();for(int value:nums)count.merge(value,1,Integer::sum);length=nums.length;return dfs(0,0,false);}private int dfs(int depth,int previous,boolean hasPrevious){if(depth==length)return 1;int ways=0;for(int value:new ArrayList<>(count.keySet()))if(count.get(value)>0&&(!hasPrevious||square(previous+value))){count.put(value,count.get(value)-1);ways+=dfs(depth+1,value,true);count.put(value,count.get(value)+1);}return ways;}private boolean square(int value){int root=(int)Math.sqrt(value);return root*root==value;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var count:MutableMap<Int,Int>;private var length=0;fun numSquarefulPerms(nums:IntArray):Int{count=mutableMapOf();for(value in nums)count[value]=(count[value]?:0)+1;length=nums.size;return dfs(0,0,false)};private fun dfs(depth:Int,previous:Int,hasPrevious:Boolean):Int{if(depth==length)return 1;var ways=0;for(value in count.keys.toList())if(count[value]!!>0&&(!hasPrevious||square(previous+value))){count[value]=count[value]!!-1;ways+=dfs(depth+1,value,true);count[value]=count[value]!!+1};return ways};private fun square(value:Int):Boolean{val root=kotlin.math.sqrt(value.toDouble()).toInt();return root*root==value} }
code.cpp: class Solution { unordered_map<int,int> count;int length;bool square(int value){int root=sqrt(value);return root*root==value;}int dfs(int depth,int previous,bool hasPrevious){if(depth==length)return 1;int ways=0;for(auto& entry:count){int value=entry.first;if(entry.second>0&&(!hasPrevious||square(previous+value))){--entry.second;ways+=dfs(depth+1,value,true);++entry.second;}}return ways;}public:int numSquarefulPerms(vector<int>& nums){for(int value:nums)++count[value];length=nums.size();return dfs(0,0,false);} };
